attributes.Project_Name: Charles Lind Brown Gym Upfit & Flooring
attributes.Description:
The Charles "Lind" Brown Gymnasium is an actively used facility for athletic programming, particularly during the Winter Basketball season. However, the gym floor is outdated and no longer meets the standards required for hosting competitive games. In addition, the existing basketball goals are not height-adjustable, limiting their suitability for the range of age groups served by our programs. The wall-mounted scoreboard is nonfunctional, and the bleachers are in need of replacement.

With athletic program participation growing each season and exceeding the capacity of the Burton Wells Gym, this facility will play an increasingly vital role. Renovating the gym floor, updating equipment, and improving spectator seating will enhance the experience for participants and better support the expanding needs of the Parks and Recreation athletic department.
attributes.latestComment: Center closed for 3 weeks starting Dec 1st to complete facility improvements.

attributes.Description: The exterior stucco of the facility is in critical need of repair and repainting due to issues stemming from a faulty original installation, general wear and tear around loading doors, damage from landscaping equipment, and nesting birds. The scope of work will also include repainting the recreation area enclosures and exterior trim to restore the building's appearance and protect it from further deterioration.
attributes.latestComment: Nearing completion. Working on the last set of recreation yard fences.

attributes.Location: 273 Squire Pope Rd, Hilton head Island, SC 29926
attributes.Description: Ford's Shell Ring is a significant archaeological and cultural site featuring a 4,000-year-old Native American shell ring, located on Squire Pope Road on Hilton Head Island. The property is co-owned by Beaufort County and the Town of Hilton Head Island, and is listed on the National Register of Historic Places. The Hilton Head Island Archaeological Society (HHI-AS) serves as a partner and official Friends group for the site, supporting preservation, education, and interpretation efforts.
attributes.latestComment: Preparing to send out for bid
